note: stop_detail conflates two distinct formulas: the 0.4/0.4/0.2 weighted combination of token entropy/self-consistency/semantic variance is the paper's GENERATION uncertainty score, not the evidence filtering/ranking score. Evidence is actually filtered/ranked via Eq.6 (retrieval relevance x source-intent weight x (1-alpha*evidence_uncertainty), alpha=0.5, retain top 70% per source, then top-K=10 via Eq.7); the paper does not specify how evidence_uncertainty itself is computed. All three key numbers confirmed exactly; retrieval config (UniXcoder embeddings, up to 8 candidates/source) and budget-matched Baseline RAG comparison (identical retrieval/candidate budgets, only filtering differs) both verified.
